name: Camelamamm
description: An oasis city of tea houses and camel-folk, and the patient Mr Camel who wakes its silent well.
artStyle: Painterly storybook art, warm desert light, rich golds and teals, soft brushwork
writingStyle: Third person, past tense, close to Mr Camel. Warm, gentle and wry, like a tale told over a glass of tea: clear sentences, quiet humour that comes from the characters, and small concrete desert details (kettles, sand, saffron, copper). Troubles that feel big to the people in them; for readers of about ten and up, and the grown-ups reading along. No modern slang.

book.title: Mr Camel and the Singing Well
book.author: Ahmet Kadir Zengin
book.dedication: For everyone who has ever waited for the kettle to sing.
book.epigraph: Water remembers the way home. So should you.
